dataset.selection: Fixed development subset used only for prompt-format calibration; not held out

conditions.instruction: Reason through the problem step by step using clear explanatory sentences before giving the answer.
Use no more than six necessary reasoning steps. Write one short step per line and omit all optional explanation.
Use a short draft. Write one atomic reasoning step per line, use at most five words per line, prefer equations and standard abbreviations, and do not write explanatory paragraphs.

Use exactly this compact symbolic-sketch structure: one GIVEN: line, one TARGET: line, one or more numbered step lines beginning S1:, S2:, and so on as needed, then one CHECK: line. Put one compact relation or operation on each line and do not write explanatory paragraphs.

Write the reasoning only with mathematical symbols, numbers, variables, equations, standard operators, and LaTeX commands. Do not use explanatory prose. The final answer may use the normal answer format.

prompt_provenance.status: Controlled format-calibration adaptations, not exact paper replications. All conditions use eight authored examples with matched questions, mathematical content, order, and final answers; only reasoning presentation changes.
prompt_provenance.symbolic: Operational replacement for the failed only-numbers condition

calibration_decision_rule.status: Predeclared screening rule for entry into a later held-out study; automatic proxies are not final verdicts

prompt_builder_source:
def prompt(spec: dict[str, Any], problem: dict[str, Any], condition: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Compose one user message with condition-specific matched demonstrations.

    All demonstration variants share questions, order and final answers. Target
    reference answers never enter this function's rendered prompt.
    """
    style = condition["demo_style"]
    examples = ""
    if style is not None:
        parts = [f"Example {i+1}\nProblem:\n{d['question']}\nSolution:\n"
                 f"{d['reasoning'][style]}\nAnswer: {d['answer']}"
                 for i, d in enumerate(spec["demonstrations"])]
        examples = "\n\nWorked examples:\n" + "\n\n".join(parts)
    return ("Solve the following mathematics problem.\n" + condition["instruction"]
            + "\nPut only the final answer on the last line, prefixed by 'Answer:'."
            + examples + "\n\nNow solve this problem only:\n" + problem["question"])

demonstrations.encoding: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=False; sort_keys=True; separators=(',', ':'); allow_nan=False
demonstrations.note: Eight authored examples omitted here; a companion historical prompt-assets.json may supply them. Benchmark question and reference text remain omitted.

historical_combined_metadata.note: Accuracy bounds reflect unresolved answers, not confidence intervals.

interpretation.role: Development/calibration pilot; same five non-held-out questions in both experiments.
interpretation.grades: Preserved archived automatic conservative-literal decisions, not regraded from raw responses.
interpretation.style_proxies: Numeric line and alphabetic-run proxies only; no human compliance decisions exist in these source reports.
interpretation.bounds: Unresolved-answer lower/upper bounds retain every collected generation in the denominator; not confidence intervals.
interpretation.reproduction_scope: CPU aggregation of frozen per-generation scalars; not inference, answer extraction, boundary extraction, style recomputation, or human adjudication.
